agent: text wave, brief A (effect leaves CAddCoreEffect .. CMetalPoolEffect)
question: What each of 39 effect classes writes as its line in an option's or decision's tooltip: its slot-9 GetText body, word for word, and the two slot-10 GetTargetText bodies in this range.

addresses.name: CAddCoreEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddCoreEffect::GetText(CAddCoreEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **`add_core`'s line.** Slot 9, 0x5A0240 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5A0606. Asks its own slot 10 (CAddCoreEffect::GetTargetText) for the province's name; where that is empty it says nothing. Otherwise `NEW_CORE_EFFECT` ('Gain core on §Y$NEW$§W.\n') with $NEW$ filled by **GetText of the string "§Y" + group + label + "§W"**, rendered in place - the 0x38-byte text replacement (vftable 0x11FE340). That string is no key, and a key the localisation lacks renders as its own text, so $NEW$ is the yellow list. **This is one of the two bodies that read `group`**: the base slot 8 (0x59C710) hands the last effect of a run of `add_core`s the earlier labels joined by "§W,§Y ", so a run reads 'Gain core on A, B, C.' on one line. The trailing int is not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9A0240..0x9A0609 read with strings: slot-10 call through the vftable (+0x28), the String_Equals against "" and the empty arm, 'NEW_CORE_EFFECT' (0x15F3A4C), 'NEW' (0x15C192C), "§Y" (0x15B5C54) + [ebp+0x10] (the group, `lea edx,[ebp+0x10]` at 0x9A035C) + label + "§W" (0x15B6700) into GetText (0xA82490). Holder count 1 (vtable.py --holding). Would be wrong if the operatorPlusChars at 0x9A0360 took a different string than the group - the lea says it does not.

addresses.name: CAddCoreEffect::GetTargetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddCoreEffect::GetTargetText(CAddCoreEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope)
addresses.comment: **The label slot 8 folds `add_core`s with: the province's bare name, or nothing.** Slot 10, 0x5A0040 to the `ret 8` at 0x5A0233. The province is `+0x28`, else `scope->province (+0x28)`, and with use_from (+0x1D) `scope->from_province (+0x30)` whatever +0x28 held. The country is the scope's (+0x10/+0x14), replaced by the effect's tag (+0x20/+0x24) where its id is set; with use_this (+0x1C) `EventScope_GetCountryTag`; with the tag `REB` the country the scope's rebel faction (scope +0x20/+0x24, FindPersistentById) stands for (its +0x44/+0x48 where its type's +0x190 is set, else 0xBC800 of it where +0x18C is - not read further). **Empty where the country's id is 0 or the province's core list (+0x344 chain) already holds it**; otherwise CProvince::GetName of the province, uncoloured. Province 0 is not guarded. CRemCoreEffect's slot 10 (0x5A08D0, not this brief's) is the same code with its fields four bytes later.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9A0040..0x9A0236 read whole; the core walk compares node+4 with the id and follows node+0xC, then calls slot 7 of the province's +8 table (CProvince::GetName). Diffed against 0x9A08D0: identical but for +0x20/+0x24/+0x28 becoming +0x24/+0x28/+0x2C. Holder count 1. The REB arm's rebel-faction fields are inferred from the shape only.

addresses.name: CAddCountryModifierEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddCountryModifierEffect::GetText(CAddCountryModifierEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment:
**`add_country_modifier`'s line.** Slot 9, 0x5A3940 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5A3ED8. Nothing where the modifier (+0x24) is null or the scope country's active_modifiers (CCountry +0x648) already holds it - the same test Execute makes. Otherwise `MODIFIER_ADDED` ("$WHERE$ gets '§Y$WHAT$§W' until §Y$DATE$§W, giving the following effects:
$EFFECT$

") with $WHERE$ = the scope country's name (CountryNameOfTag, uncoloured), $WHAT$ = GetText of the modifier's slot 6 (its localised display name) rendered in place, $DATE$ = FormatHourDate (' H:00, D Month, Y', **a leading space**) of the defines' end_date where the duration (+0x20, whole days) is below 1, else of the current hour + duration x 24, and $EFFECT$ = GetText of the modifier's slot 7 (every value it holds, a line each) rendered in place. `group` and the trailing int are not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9A3940..0x9A3EDB with strings: 'MODIFIER_ADDED' 0x15F3AFC, 'WHERE' 0x15C2E18, 'WHAT' 0x15F3B0C, 'DATE' 0x15BC970 twice (two arms on `+0x20 < 1`), 'EFFECT' 0x15C0B54; slot calls at +0x18 and +0x1C of the modifier's table. Holder count 1. Would be wrong if +0x24 were not the CStaticModifier - CAddCountryModifierEffect::Execute (0x5A38A0) reads it as one.

addresses.name: CAddProvinceModifierEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddProvinceModifierEffect::GetText(CAddProvinceModifierEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **`add_province_modifier`'s line**, the country one's on a province. Slot 9, 0x5A3170 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5A389B. Nothing where the modifier (+0x24) is null or the scope province's modifier list already holds it. Otherwise `MODIFIER_ADDED` with $WHERE$ = GetText of the province's name rendered in place (uncoloured), $WHAT$, $DATE$ and $EFFECT$ as add_country_modifier's. The province is `scope->province (+0x28)`, unguarded, so a country-scoped one speaks of province 0. `group` and the trailing int are not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9A3170..0x9A389E: the same six strings as 0x9A3940, the province from `provinces (+0xB8C)[scope+0x28]`, its modifier chain walked node[0]+8 against +0x24. Holder count 1.

addresses.name: CAddDivisionEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddDivisionEffect::GetText(CAddDivisionEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **`add_division` says nothing.** Slot 9, 0x5B5FA0 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5B60A0, 0x103 bytes: it builds the **empty string**, hands it to GetText (0x682490) as the key and renders that into `out`. GetText sends a key of length 0 straight to its missing-key path, where 0x686DA0 answers the database's fixed entry at +0x24 for it, and the entry made there is parsed from the empty key - so the line is empty (inferred: the render of that entry was not followed to the end). Nothing of the effect - its name, its province, its brigades - is read. `group` and the trailing int are not read. Read 2026-10-12; the record had the name from the slot alone.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9B5FA0..0x9B60A3 read whole: one assign of "" (0x15B4945, length 0), GetText, Render, release - no read of ecx's fields at all. GetText 0xA824EF `cmp [esi+0x10],0; je` and 0xA86DA0 `test eax,eax; jne` / `lea eax,[edi+0x24]` read. Would be wrong if the entry at database+0x24 ever held text - only the missing-key path writes it.

addresses.name: CAddSubUnitEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddSubUnitEffect::GetText(CAddSubUnitEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **The line of a unit type as an effect (`infantry_brigade = 1234`).** Slot 9, 0x5A8BC0 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5A90F8. Gated on the definition's (+0x24) slot 9, which for CSubUnitDefinition is the shared answer-true stub 0x692590, so always passed. `ADD_SUB_UNIT_EFFECT` ('Get $UNIT$ in §Y$WHERE$§W.') with $WHERE$ = GetText of "§Y" + group + its slot 10's province name + "§W", rendered in place (so a run of them folds to one line, as add_core's), and $UNIT$ = "§Y" + the definition's slot 6 (its key, localised) + "§W" as a plain string; **then "\n" is appended to the rendered text**, which the key lacks. The other body that reads `group`. The trailing int is not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9A8BC0..0x9A90FB with strings: 'ADD_SUB_UNIT_EFFECT' 0x15F3BD4, 'WHERE', 'UNIT' 0x15C17EC, "\n" 0x15B57D0 appended after Render (0x9A902F, then operatorPlus into [ebp+8]); `lea ecx,[ebp+0x10]` at 0x9A8CB6 is the group. Definition slot 9 is `call [eax+0x24]`; vtable.py gives CSubUnitDefinition slot 9 = 0xA92590 and slot 6 = 0x5A38A0 (GetText of the key at +8, rendered). Holder count 1.

addresses.name: CAddSubUnitEffect::GetTargetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAddSubUnitEffect::GetTargetText(CAddSubUnitEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope)
addresses.comment: **A unit-type effect's label: the name of the province it puts the brigade in, never empty.** Slot 10, 0x5A8B40 to the `ret 8` at 0x5A8BB7. The province is `g_CMap +0x2200 [value (+0x20) / 1000]`; with use_this `this_scope (+0x38)->province (+0x28)`, with use_from `this_scope->from_province (+0x30)`, with use_current (+0x28) `scope->province`. CProvince::GetName of it, uncoloured.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9A8B40..0x9A8BBA read whole (0x7A bytes, one ret 8). Holder count 1.

addresses.name: CAllOrganisationPopularityEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CAllOrganisationPopularityEffect::GetText(CAllOrganisationPopularityEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **An ideology's block (`fascistic = { organisation = 5 popularity = 5 }`).** Slot 9, 0x5B9000 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5B9733. Nothing where the ideology (+0x24) is null. Where organisation (+0x28) >= 0 **or** popularity (+0x2C) >= 0: `ADD_ORGANISATION_POPULARITY_EFFECT` ('§Y$IDEOLOGY$§W gains §G$ORGANISATION$§W in organisation and §G$POPULARITY$§W in popularity§W.\n'), each figure FormatFixedPointTrimmed and, **where that one is negative, wrapped "§R" ... "§W"** with its minus sign. Where both are negative: `REMOVE_ORGANISATION_POPULARITY_EFFECT` ('... loses §R$ORGANISATION$§W ...'), both figures FormatFixedPointTrimmed **with their minus signs** ('loses -5'). $IDEOLOGY$ is the ideology's slot 14 for the scope's country tag (0x129120: the localisation of '<ideology>_<TAG>', falling back to the ideology's own name where that key is missing). `group` and the trailing int are not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9B9000..0x9B9736: `cmp [edi+0x24],0; je` empty; `cmp [edi+0x28],0; jge ADD`, `cmp [edi+0x2c],0; jge ADD`, then REMOVE; no `neg` anywhere in the body; ADD arm's `jl 0x9B93BD` builds §R (0x15B5C58) + figure + §W. Slot 14 is `call [eax+0x38]` with the scope's tag pushed; 0x529120's key is `this+0x30` + '_' (0x15C1814) + tag and its fallback is `call [eax+0x34]` after String_Equals(rendered, key). Holder count 1.

addresses.name: CBuildingEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CBuildingEffect::GetText(CBuildingEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **A building as an effect (`industry = 1`).** Slot 9, 0x5B8940 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x5B8E92. The province is `scope->province (+0x28)`, unguarded. **Where the effect's value (+0x20) is below the building's working level in that province (CProvinceBuilding +0x24)** it is `REMOVE_BUILDING_EFFECT` ('Lose §Y$BUILDING$§W with level §Y$VALUE$§W in §Y$PROVINCE$§W.\n'), otherwise `ADD_BUILDING_EFFECT` ('Gain ...'). $BUILDING$ = the building's slot 6 (its localised name, +0x38), $PROVINCE$ = the province's name, $VALUE$ = FormatFixedPointTrimmed(value) - the effect's own figure, not a resulting level. **Execute adds the value to the built level**, so the word turns on a comparison Execute never makes: `industry = 1` where industry works at 3 reads 'Lose Industry with level 1'. `group` and the trailing int are not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x9B89D8..0x9B8A12: province [scope+0x28], building array +0x310 indexed by building +0x54, `mov eax,[ecx+0x24]; cmp [edi+0x20]... jl REMOVE`. Strings 0x15F4168/0x15F4188/'BUILDING'/'PROVINCE'/'VALUE'. CBuilding slot 6 = 0x4B6730 copies +0x38 (displayName). Execute's `level_max + v` per FINDINGS-effectrun.md 1.9. Holder count 1.

addresses.name: CCapitalEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CCapitalEffect::GetText(CCapitalEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **`capital`'s line.** Slot 9, 0x59F080 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x59F448. Nothing where the scope country's capital (`capital_province_id`) already is value (+0x20) / 1000. Otherwise `CAPITAL_CHANGE` ('§Y$NEW$§W will become the new capital.\n') with $NEW$ = GetText of "§Y" + the name of province value/1000 + "§W", rendered in place. Reads only +0x20: use_this/use_from are ignored here as in Execute, so `capital = this` speaks of province 0. `group` and the trailing int are not read.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x99F080..0x99F44B: /1000 by `imul 0x10624DD3; sar 6`, provinces +0xB8C, province slot 7 at +8 (+0x1C), 'CAPITAL_CHANGE' 0x15F3A2C, 'NEW'. Holder count 1.

addresses.name: CChangeManpowerEffect::GetText

addresses.name: CContextEffect::GetText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CContextEffect::GetText(CContextEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **A scope's own head: "(" + the country's name + "): ", or nothing.** Slot 9, 0x59E300 to the `ret 0x28` at 0x59E517. It calls CEventScope::MakeScope(scope, &this->spec, &local) at 0x59E337 and writes **`(` (0x11B6C90) + CountryNameOfCountry(the new scope's country) + `): ` (0x11F39E4)** where the new scope resolved (`+0x3C`), its country id (`+0x14`) is not 0 and **is not the player's** (CCurrentGameState +0xC34); otherwise the empty string. No key, no colour, no line break - slot 8 puts the children's lines after it. So a province scope, an unresolved one and the player's own country head nothing. `group` and the trailing int are not read. Read past the gate 2026-10-12.
addresses.evidence: VAs. Listing 0x99E300..0x99E51A read whole: `cmp byte [ebp-0x8C],0` (local scope +0x3C), `cmp [ebp-0xB4],0` (+0x14), `cmp edi,[eax+0xC34]`, then the two strings and two operatorPlus with esi = [ebp+8] (out). Would be wrong if +0xC34 were not the played country - CCurrentGameState's record names it.
